text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne — a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web apps with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS.

I’m interested in helping you build a Print on Demand Shopify store for Beach Soul Clothing. Your focus on compelling, meaningful beach-lifestyle designs sounds like a strong fit for a clean, conversion-friendly storefront, and I’d be glad to help turn your product ideas into a polished store that feels cohesive, professional, and ready for growth. I can support both the technical build and the product presentation, and I’m happy to contribute creative input where it helps strengthen the overall shopping experience.

One project I’m proud of was Embedded customer analytics for a confidential B2B SaaS client. I built usage dashboards embedded inside their product so each customer account could see its own metrics. The rollout reached 140 customer accounts, and the work was delivered 3 weeks early. That project required thoughtful UI structure, reliable frontend implementation, and careful handling of account-specific data, which translates well to building a store with many products, organized collections, and a smooth customer experience.

For your Shopify project, I can help with:
- Store setup and product page structure
- Building out the initial product line of 50 to 60 items
- Clean, responsive design for desktop and mobile
- Custom sections and layout improvements
- Product organization, navigation, and conversion-focused UX
- Integrating key ecommerce functionality where needed

I also understand the value of a long-term working relationship. If the first phase goes well, I’d be glad to continue supporting future updates, additions, and improvements as your store grows.

If helpful, I can provide two samples of work I’m proud of that best reflect the type of product experience you’re looking for. I’m also happy to discuss whether an hourly rate or milestone-based project price makes the most sense for phase one.
